tools.name: context_pack
tools.description: Build the offline RAG context pack for a market or full brief — retailers, frontier sister, this-month local ingredient, dialect traps, nearest visual cluster, sample Kodiak copy, brand rules. Composes context_pack.build_context_pack; the to_prompt_text closure is stripped, prompt_text string is kept.

month.description: ISO YYYY-MM; defaults to current month

tools.name: retailer_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a retailer name to its logo lockup asset (SVG preferred, PNG fallback) plus an optional local store address for the overlay. Reports which files are present/missing — never fabricates a logo. Composes retailers.resolve_retailer.

store_address.description: Optional store address string for the lockup

tools.name: dam_hero_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a product hero image path. S3-first when DAM_S3_BUCKET is set, else pure local input_assets/<product_id>/hero.* fallback. Offline-safe: a miss returns hero_path null + a note, never raises. Composes dam.find_hero_asset.

explicit.description: Explicit local or s3:// path override

tools.name: asset_library_browse
tools.description: Browse the DAM asset library (optionally filtered by kind: raster/vector/doc/copy) and return AssetRef dicts. Offline-safe: with no S3/creds the library runs in no-s3 mode and returns an empty list + a note. Composes asset_library.AssetLibrary.list_assets.

tools.name: recipe_card_plan
tools.description: Plan a monthly recipe card for a market — the metadata (ingredient, recipe, text_blocks, safety) with NO PNG render by default. Pass out_dir to also render the card PNG. Ingredient is never fabricated. Composes recipe_card.build_recipe_card.

month.description: ISO YYYY-MM; defaults to current month

out_dir.description: If set, also render the card PNG here

tools.name: monthly_ingredient
tools.description: Resolve a market + month to its in-season local ingredient, frontier sister place, and retailer set. Never fabricates — an unseeded market returns ingredient null + a note. Composes locales.resolve_this_month.

month.description: ISO YYYY-MM; defaults to current month

tools.name: run_campaign_tool
tools.description: Run a full campaign through the C1 runtime handler. Pass an event dict (market or brief, optional month/platforms/languages/render) either flat or under 'event'. Returns the C1 payload with its own ok flag. Thin passthrough to runtime.handle_campaign_request.

event.description: Full C1 event dict (alternative to flat args)
